testcase.name: validation rejects invalid zones coordinates and invented sources
city name and address search is case tolerant and favorites do not select anything
wrong preference types recover without crashing and favorites are independent
OSM record retains its source and has no made up schedule
approximate location returns options outside the old 500 meter radius
oversized saves fail without losing the previously saved records
a personal temple keeps a stable identity without borrowing a schedule
pinning requires a fresh fix while nearby search can reuse a recent one
complete map names and addresses survive storage without silent truncation
own temple without invented validity dates is safe for the shared schedule API
invalid entries do not discard neighboring valid temples
